units.title: Savolni paraphrase qilish: kirish gapi
units.simple_explanation: Kirishda savoldagi ma’lumotni boshqa so‘zlar bilan ayting. Yangi raqam yoki xulosa qo‘shmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: The chart/graph/table + shows/illustrates/compares + what + where/when.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Savolni paraphrase qilish: kirish gapi». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Kirishda savoldagi ma’lumotni boshqa so‘zlar bilan ayting. Yangi raqam yoki xulosa qo‘shmang.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: The line graph compares household internet access in three regions from 2010 to 2025.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: Chiziqli grafik 2010-yildan 2025-yilgacha uch hududda xonadonlarning internetga ulanish darajasini taqqoslaydi.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: The chart/graph/table + shows/illustrates/compares + what + where/when.
Esda tuting: Kirishda savoldagi ma’lumotni boshqa so‘zlar bilan ayting. Yangi raqam yoki xulosa qo‘shmang.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1: grafik tavsifida zamonlar (Tenses in Task 1). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da zamon tanlash grafikning vaqt oralig'iga bog'liq: o'tmish, hozirgi payt yoki kelajak prognozi. Baholovchi hisobotda zamonlar izchil almashishini kuzatadi. Bu darsda to'rt vaqt oralig'i va ular uchun to'g'ri zamonlar tizimlashtiriladi.

O'tmish davri: Past Simple. Grafik tugallangan o'tmishni ko'rsatsa (1990-2010), asosiy zamon Past Simple: «The figure rose from 20 to 45 percent». Davr ichidagi o'zgarishlar ham shu zamonda beriladi: peaked, fell, remained stable, fluctuated.

Hozirgacha davom etgan: Present Perfect. Agar davr hozirgacha yetib kelsa (2010-yildan hozirgacha), Present Perfect yoki Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi: «The number has risen steadily since 2010». «Rose steadily since 2010» — xato.

Kelajak prognozi. Prognoz qismi alohida zamon talab qiladi: is projected to, is expected to, will + V1, will have + V3. «By 2030, the figure is expected to reach 60 percent» — bu tuzilma hisobotning eng kuchli qismi bo'ladi.

Statik va dinamik fe'llar. Grafik tavsifida statik fe'llar (stood at, accounted for, represented, comprised) va dinamik fe'llar (rose, fell, doubled, halved, peaked) almashib turadi. Faqat «increased/decreased» dan foydalanish leksik boylikni cheklaydi.

The line graph compares the proportion of households with internet access in three fictional regions from 2010 to 2025.

Overall, all three regions experienced growth, but the rise was much stronger in regions A and B than in region C. Region C started with the largest proportion, while region A finished in first place.

In 2010, the figure for region A was 28 percent, compared with just 20 percent for region B and 45 percent for region C. By 2015, these figures had increased to 41, 36 and 48 percent, respectively. Region C therefore remained ahead at the midpoint of the period.

Region A continued to rise, reaching 57 percent in 2020 and 76 percent in 2025. Region B also climbed steadily, from 48 percent in 2020 to 67 percent five years later. In comparison, region C increased more slowly, reaching 52 and then 55 percent.

By the end of the period, the gap between regions A and C stood at 21 percentage points. Region B, despite starting last, overtook region C by 2025. The graph provides no information about why these differences occurred.

The line graph compares the proportion of households with internet access in three fictional regions from 2010 to 2025.

Overall, all three regions experienced growth, but the rise was much stronger in regions A and B than in region C. Region C started with the largest proportion, while region A finished in first place.

In 2010, the figure for region A was 28 percent, compared with just 20 percent for region B and 45 percent for region C. By 2015, these figures had increased to 41, 36 and 48 percent, respectively. Region C therefore remained ahead at the midpoint of the period.

Region A continued to rise, reaching 57 percent in 2020 and 76 percent in 2025. Region B also climbed steadily, from 48 percent in 2020 to 67 percent five years later. In comparison, region C increased more slowly, reaching 52 and then 55 percent.

By the end of the period, the gap between regions A and C stood at 21 percentage points. Region B, despite starting last, overtook region C by 2025. The graph provides no information about why these differences occurred.

items.answer:
The line chart illustrates the number of passengers using two fictional bus routes between 2016 and 2026, with values measured in thousands.

Overall, passenger numbers on route A fluctuated considerably but ended higher than they began, whereas route B remained almost unchanged throughout the period.

Route A served 36 thousand passengers in 2016, below the 43 thousand recorded for route B. Two years later, route A had risen sharply to 49 thousand, overtaking route B, which had edged down to 42 thousand.

By 2020, route A had climbed to 65 thousand passengers. It then fell to 52 thousand in 2022 and 50 thousand in 2024 before recovering to 68 thousand in 2026. Route B, in contrast, moved only slightly, staying between 42 and 44 thousand.

Thus, route A ended the period 24 thousand passengers above route B. It also had a much wider range between its lowest and highest readings. No reasons for the fluctuations are supplied in the chart.

units.title: Ko'tarilish va tushish: verb va noun shakllari
units.simple_explanation: Increase fe’l ham, ot ham bo‘la oladi. Fe’l bilan subject, ot bilan there was a/an ishlatiladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: X rose/fell by N; there was a rise/fall of N in X.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Ko'tarilish va tushish: verb va noun shakllari». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Increase fe’l ham, ot ham bo‘la oladi. Fe’l bilan subject, ot bilan there was a/an ishlatiladi.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: There was an increase of 48 percentage points in Region A's internet access between 2010 and 2025.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2010–2025-yillarda A hududida internetga ulanish darajasi 48 foiz punktiga oshgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X rose/fell by N; there was a rise/fall of N in X.
Esda tuting: Increase fe’l ham, ot ham bo‘la oladi. Fe’l bilan subject, ot bilan there was a/an ishlatiladi.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1: grafik tavsifida zamonlar (Tenses in Task 1). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da zamon tanlash grafikning vaqt oralig'iga bog'liq: o'tmish, hozirgi payt yoki kelajak prognozi. Baholovchi hisobotda zamonlar izchil almashishini kuzatadi. Bu darsda to'rt vaqt oralig'i va ular uchun to'g'ri zamonlar tizimlashtiriladi.

O'tmish davri: Past Simple. Grafik tugallangan o'tmishni ko'rsatsa (1990-2010), asosiy zamon Past Simple: «The figure rose from 20 to 45 percent». Davr ichidagi o'zgarishlar ham shu zamonda beriladi: peaked, fell, remained stable, fluctuated.

Hozirgacha davom etgan: Present Perfect. Agar davr hozirgacha yetib kelsa (2010-yildan hozirgacha), Present Perfect yoki Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi: «The number has risen steadily since 2010». «Rose steadily since 2010» — xato.

Kelajak prognozi. Prognoz qismi alohida zamon talab qiladi: is projected to, is expected to, will + V1, will have + V3. «By 2030, the figure is expected to reach 60 percent» — bu tuzilma hisobotning eng kuchli qismi bo'ladi.

Statik va dinamik fe'llar. Grafik tavsifida statik fe'llar (stood at, accounted for, represented, comprised) va dinamik fe'llar (rose, fell, doubled, halved, peaked) almashib turadi. Faqat «increased/decreased» dan foydalanish leksik boylikni cheklaydi.

items.answer:
The line graph compares the proportion of households with internet access in three fictional regions from 2010 to 2025.

Overall, all three regions experienced growth, but the rise was much stronger in regions A and B than in region C. Region C started with the largest proportion, while region A finished in first place.

In 2010, the figure for region A was 28 percent, compared with just 20 percent for region B and 45 percent for region C. By 2015, these figures had increased to 41, 36 and 48 percent, respectively. Region C therefore remained ahead at the midpoint of the period.

Region A continued to rise, reaching 57 percent in 2020 and 76 percent in 2025. Region B also climbed steadily, from 48 percent in 2020 to 67 percent five years later. In comparison, region C increased more slowly, reaching 52 and then 55 percent.

By the end of the period, the gap between regions A and C stood at 21 percentage points. Region B, despite starting last, overtook region C by 2025. The graph provides no information about why these differences occurred.

units.title: Cho'qqi, tubi, tekis davr: peak, bottom, plateau, fluctuate
units.simple_explanation: Eng yuqori, eng past va tekis bosqichni farqlang. Peak at qiymatni bildiradi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: X peaked at N / reached a low of N / remained stable at N.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Cho'qqi, tubi, tekis davr: peak, bottom, plateau, fluctuate». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Eng yuqori, eng past va tekis bosqichni farqlang. Peak at qiymatni bildiradi.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: Route A peaked at 68 thousand passengers in 2026, while Route B remained close to 43 thousand throughout.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: A yo‘nalishidagi yo‘lovchilar soni 2026-yilda 68 ming bilan cho‘qqiga chiqqan, B yo‘nalishida esa butun davr davomida 43 ming atrofida qolgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X peaked at N / reached a low of N / remained stable at N.
Esda tuting: Eng yuqori, eng past va tekis bosqichni farqlang. Peak at qiymatni bildiradi.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1: grafik tavsifida zamonlar (Tenses in Task 1). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da zamon tanlash grafikning vaqt oralig'iga bog'liq: o'tmish, hozirgi payt yoki kelajak prognozi. Baholovchi hisobotda zamonlar izchil almashishini kuzatadi. Bu darsda to'rt vaqt oralig'i va ular uchun to'g'ri zamonlar tizimlashtiriladi.

O'tmish davri: Past Simple. Grafik tugallangan o'tmishni ko'rsatsa (1990-2010), asosiy zamon Past Simple: «The figure rose from 20 to 45 percent». Davr ichidagi o'zgarishlar ham shu zamonda beriladi: peaked, fell, remained stable, fluctuated.

Hozirgacha davom etgan: Present Perfect. Agar davr hozirgacha yetib kelsa (2010-yildan hozirgacha), Present Perfect yoki Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi: «The number has risen steadily since 2010». «Rose steadily since 2010» — xato.

Kelajak prognozi. Prognoz qismi alohida zamon talab qiladi: is projected to, is expected to, will + V1, will have + V3. «By 2030, the figure is expected to reach 60 percent» — bu tuzilma hisobotning eng kuchli qismi bo'ladi.

Statik va dinamik fe'llar. Grafik tavsifida statik fe'llar (stood at, accounted for, represented, comprised) va dinamik fe'llar (rose, fell, doubled, halved, peaked) almashib turadi. Faqat «increased/decreased» dan foydalanish leksik boylikni cheklaydi.

items.answer:
The line chart illustrates the number of passengers using two fictional bus routes between 2016 and 2026, with values measured in thousands.

Overall, passenger numbers on route A fluctuated considerably but ended higher than they began, whereas route B remained almost unchanged throughout the period.

Route A served 36 thousand passengers in 2016, below the 43 thousand recorded for route B. Two years later, route A had risen sharply to 49 thousand, overtaking route B, which had edged down to 42 thousand.

By 2020, route A had climbed to 65 thousand passengers. It then fell to 52 thousand in 2022 and 50 thousand in 2024 before recovering to 68 thousand in 2026. Route B, in contrast, moved only slightly, staying between 42 and 44 thousand.

Thus, route A ended the period 24 thousand passengers above route B. It also had a much wider range between its lowest and highest readings. No reasons for the fluctuations are supplied in the chart.

units.title: Vaqt ifodalari: in, by, over, between, from ... to, during
units.simple_explanation: In bitta yilni, by muddat chegarasini, from...to oraliqning ikki uchini ko‘rsatadi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: in YEAR; by YEAR; from X to Y; between YEAR and YEAR.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Vaqt ifodalari: in, by, over, between, from ... to, during». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: In bitta yilni, by muddat chegarasini, from...to oraliqning ikki uchini ko‘rsatadi.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: Between 2010 and 2025, internet access in Region B rose from 20% to 67%.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2010–2025-yillarda B hududida internetga ulanish darajasi 20 foizdan 67 foizgacha oshgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: in YEAR; by YEAR; from X to Y; between YEAR and YEAR.
Esda tuting: In bitta yilni, by muddat chegarasini, from...to oraliqning ikki uchini ko‘rsatadi.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Vaqt predloglari (Prepositions of Time). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

in, on, at — vaqt predloglari. Qoida oddiy ko'rinadi, lekin imtihonda «in 2020» va «on Monday» kabi birikmalar tez-tez xato qilinadi. Task 1'da yillar, oylar va davrlar doimiy ishlatiladi, shuning uchun ularni avtomatlashtirish kerak.

in: katta davrlar. in yil, oy, fasl, asr va uzoq davrlar bilan: in 2020, in July, in winter, in the 1990s, in the 21st century. Shuningdek «in the morning/afternoon/evening» birikmalarida ham ishlatiladi.
on: kun va sana. on hafta kuni va aniq sana bilan: on Monday, on 5 September, on my birthday. «on the morning of 5 May» — aniq sana bo'lsa on. Bu farq «in the morning» bilan qiyoslanganda muhim.
at: aniq vaqt va nuqta. at soat va aniq vaqt nuqtasi bilan: at 7 o'clock, at noon, at midnight, at the weekend, at Christmas. «at night» ham at bilan keladi, «in the night» emas.

Boshqa muhim predloglar. since + boshlanish, for + davomiylik, during + davr ichida, until + oxirgi nuqta, by + muddat, within + ichida. «During the 1990s» (davr ichida) va «for ten years» (davomiylik) farqini bilish kerak.

The line graph compares the proportion of households with internet access in three fictional regions from 2010 to 2025.

Overall, all three regions experienced growth, but the rise was much stronger in regions A and B than in region C. Region C started with the largest proportion, while region A finished in first place.

units.title: Kelajak prognozi: is expected to, is projected to, will
units.simple_explanation: Kelajak ko‘rsatkichi taxmin bo‘lsa, natijani aniq fakt sifatida yozmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: X is expected/projected to + V + by YEAR.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Kelajak prognozi: is expected to, is projected to, will». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Kelajak ko‘rsatkichi taxmin bo‘lsa, natijani aniq fakt sifatida yozmang.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: Online-course enrolment is projected to reach 72% by 2035.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2035-yilga kelib onlayn kurslarga yozilish ulushi 72 foizga yetishi prognoz qilinmoqda.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X is expected/projected to + V + by YEAR.
Esda tuting: Kelajak ko‘rsatkichi taxmin bo‘lsa, natijani aniq fakt sifatida yozmang.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — will va going to (Will vs Going To). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Kelajak haqida gapirishning ikki asosiy yo'li bor: will va going to. Ular ko'pincha bir-birini almashtirsa ham, ma'no nozik farq qiladi. Task 2'da kelajakdagi oqibatlarni bashorat qilish uchun will, oldindan belgilangan reja uchun esa going to ishlatiladi.

will: qaror va bashorat. will gapirish paytida qabul qilingan qaror uchun (I will help you), umumiy bashorat uchun (The situation will improve) va va'da uchun ishlatiladi. Shakl barcha shaxslarda bir xil: will + V1, inkor will not (won't).

going to: reja va dalil. going to ikki holatda ishlatiladi: oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat (The government is going to build a new hospital) va hozirgi dalilga asoslangan bashorat (Look at those clouds — it is going to rain). Ikkinchisi Task 2'da statistikaga tayangan prognoz uchun qulay.

Rasmiy prognozlar. Akademik yozuvda qat'iy «will» o'rniga ehtimollikni bildiruvchi tuzilmalar afzal: is likely to, is expected to, is projected to, may well. «The population will double» — juda qat'iy; «The population is expected to double by 2050» — aniqroq va ilmiyroq.

will bilan bog'liq tuzoqlar. will shart ergash gapida ishlatilmaydi: «If the government will act» emas, «If the government acts». Bundan tashqari, will odatda «rejalashtirilgan» ma'noda going to bilan aralashtirilmaydi: «I will meet the manager tomorrow» (qaror) va «I am going to meet the manager tomorrow» (reja) — ikkinchisi oldindan kelishilgan.

deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X began at N and ended at N; X stood at N.
Esda tuting: Birinchi va oxirgi qiymatni aniqlang. Began at va ended at ko‘rsatkich bilan ishlatiladi.

Task 1'da zamon tanlash grafikning vaqt oralig'iga bog'liq: o'tmish, hozirgi payt yoki kelajak prognozi. Baholovchi hisobotda zamonlar izchil almashishini kuzatadi. Bu darsda to'rt vaqt oralig'i va ular uchun to'g'ri zamonlar tizimlashtiriladi.

O'tmish davri: Past Simple. Grafik tugallangan o'tmishni ko'rsatsa (1990-2010), asosiy zamon Past Simple: «The figure rose from 20 to 45 percent». Davr ichidagi o'zgarishlar ham shu zamonda beriladi: peaked, fell, remained stable, fluctuated.

Hozirgacha davom etgan: Present Perfect. Agar davr hozirgacha yetib kelsa (2010-yildan hozirgacha), Present Perfect yoki Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi: «The number has risen steadily since 2010». «Rose steadily since 2010» — xato.

The line chart illustrates the number of passengers using two fictional bus routes between 2016 and 2026, with values measured in thousands.

Overall, passenger numbers on route A fluctuated considerably but ended higher than they began, whereas route B remained almost unchanged throughout the period.

Route A served 36 thousand passengers in 2016, below the 43 thousand recorded for route B. Two years later, route A had risen sharply to 49 thousand, overtaking route B, which had edged down to 42 thousand.

By 2020, route A had climbed to 65 thousand passengers. It then fell to 52 thousand in 2022 and 50 thousand in 2024 before recovering to 68 thousand in 2026. Route B, in contrast, moved only slightly, staying between 42 and 44 thousand.

Thus, route A ended the period 24 thousand passengers above route B. It also had a much wider range between its lowest and highest readings. No reasons for the fluctuations are supplied in the chart.

The bar chart compares the number of visits to museums in four fictional cities in 2020 and 2025. All figures are given in thousands.

Overall, each city recorded an increase over the period. City C had the most visitors in 2020, while city B became the leading city by 2025.

In 2020, city A registered 20 thousand visits and city D recorded 25 thousand. The corresponding figures for city B and city C were 30 and 45 thousand, making city C clearly the most visited destination at the beginning.

Five years later, the total for city A had increased to 35 thousand, while city D reached 43 thousand. City C experienced a more modest rise to 51 thousand, but city B grew sharply to 55 thousand visits.

The largest absolute increase was in city B, at 25 thousand visits, compared with 15 thousand in city A, 18 thousand in city D and only 6 thousand in city C. The chart does not identify the reasons for these changes.

units.simple_explanation: Grafikdagi yilga qarab zamon tanlang. 2010 haqida past simple, 2030 taxmini haqida projection. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: Past data → past simple; current facts → present; projections → future.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Task 1 zamonlari: o'tmish, hozir, kelajak». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Grafikdagi yilga qarab zamon tanlang. 2010 haqida past simple, 2030 taxmini haqida projection.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: In-person course enrolment stood at 60% in 2020 and is projected to fall to 38% by 2035.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: An’anaviy kurslarga yozilish ulushi 2020-yilda 60 foiz bo‘lgan va 2035-yilga borib 38 foizga tushishi prognoz qilinmoqda.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: Past data → past simple; current facts → present; projections → future.
Esda tuting: Grafikdagi yilga qarab zamon tanlang. 2010 haqida past simple, 2030 taxmini haqida projection.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1: grafik tavsifida zamonlar (Tenses in Task 1). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da zamon tanlash grafikning vaqt oralig'iga bog'liq: o'tmish, hozirgi payt yoki kelajak prognozi. Baholovchi hisobotda zamonlar izchil almashishini kuzatadi. Bu darsda to'rt vaqt oralig'i va ular uchun to'g'ri zamonlar tizimlashtiriladi.

O'tmish davri: Past Simple. Grafik tugallangan o'tmishni ko'rsatsa (1990-2010), asosiy zamon Past Simple: «The figure rose from 20 to 45 percent». Davr ichidagi o'zgarishlar ham shu zamonda beriladi: peaked, fell, remained stable, fluctuated.

Hozirgacha davom etgan: Present Perfect. Agar davr hozirgacha yetib kelsa (2010-yildan hozirgacha), Present Perfect yoki Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi: «The number has risen steadily since 2010». «Rose steadily since 2010» — xato.

Kelajak prognozi. Prognoz qismi alohida zamon talab qiladi: is projected to, is expected to, will + V1, will have + V3. «By 2030, the figure is expected to reach 60 percent» — bu tuzilma hisobotning eng kuchli qismi bo'ladi.

Statik va dinamik fe'llar. Grafik tavsifida statik fe'llar (stood at, accounted for, represented, comprised) va dinamik fe'llar (rose, fell, doubled, halved, peaked) almashib turadi. Faqat «increased/decreased» dan foydalanish leksik boylikni cheklaydi.

The graph compares enrolment in online and in-person courses between 2020 and 2035, including projected figures for the final two years shown.

Overall, the proportion of online enrolments is expected to increase throughout the period, while the share of in-person courses is projected to decline. The two series are forecast to reverse their positions after 2025.

In 2020, online courses accounted for 35 percent, compared with 60 percent for in-person classes. By 2025, the online figure had reached 46 percent, whereas the in-person share had fallen to 53 percent.

The dotted segments represent forecasts rather than observed results. According to these projections, online enrolment will rise to 58 percent in 2030 and 72 percent by 2035. In-person enrolment is projected to fall to 45 and 38 percent over the same years.

Consequently, online enrolment is predicted to exceed in-person enrolment in 2030, with a 34-percentage-point lead by 2035. These future figures are estimates and should not be presented as confirmed historical facts.

units.title: Solishtirish: like with like
units.simple_explanation: Faqat bir xil o‘lchov va mos yil qiymatlarini bevosita solishtiring. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: X and Y are compared using the same unit and time period.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Solishtirish: like with like». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Faqat bir xil o‘lchov va mos yil qiymatlarini bevosita solishtiring.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: In 2025, City B recorded 55 thousand visitors, compared with 51 thousand in City C.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2025-yilda B shahriga 55 ming, C shahriga esa 51 ming tashrif buyuruvchi kelgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X and Y are compared using the same unit and time period.
Esda tuting: Faqat bir xil o‘lchov va mos yil qiymatlarini bevosita solishtiring.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1 uchun qiyoslash tuzilmalari (Comparison Structures). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da raqamlarni shunchaki sanab chiqish yetarli emas — ularni qiyoslash kerak. Bu darsda beshta asosiy qiyoslash tuzilmasi va ularning aniq ishlatilishi ko'rsatiladi. Baholovchi aynan qiyoslash orqali «overview» qobiliyatini baholaydi.

As ... as va nisbat. «Twice as high as», «three times as many as», «half as much as». Bu tuzilmalar aniq nisbatni beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000». «Twice higher» emas, «twice as high» — to'g'ri shakl.

By + far / considerably. Farqni kuchaytirish uchun ravishlar qo'shiladi: considerably higher, significantly lower, slightly more, marginally less, by far the highest. Bu ravishlar farqning kattaligini aniq bildiradi va hisobotni yuzaki «higher/lower» dan ajratib turadi.

Whereas va compared with. «Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated». «Compared with 2010, the figure doubled». Bu tuzilmalar ikki ko'rsatkichni bir gapda qiyoslash imkonini beradi va matnni zichlashtiradi.

Proportion va raqam. «The proportion of X was higher than that of Y» (foizlar uchun), «The number of X exceeded that of Y» (sonlar uchun). Proportion va number ni aralashtirmang: proportion foizda, number sonda o'lchanadi.

items.answer:
The bar chart compares the number of visits to museums in four fictional cities in 2020 and 2025. All figures are given in thousands.

Overall, each city recorded an increase over the period. City C had the most visitors in 2020, while city B became the leading city by 2025.

In 2020, city A registered 20 thousand visits and city D recorded 25 thousand. The corresponding figures for city B and city C were 30 and 45 thousand, making city C clearly the most visited destination at the beginning.

Five years later, the total for city A had increased to 35 thousand, while city D reached 43 thousand. City C experienced a more modest rise to 51 thousand, but city B grew sharply to 55 thousand visits.

The largest absolute increase was in city B, at 25 thousand visits, compared with 15 thousand in city A, 18 thousand in city D and only 6 thousand in city C. The chart does not identify the reasons for these changes.

units.title: Not as...as: katta va kichik farq
units.simple_explanation: Not as ... as kamroq darajani bildiradi. Ikkinchi as ni unutmaymiz. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: X was not as + adjective + as Y.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Not as...as: katta va kichik farq». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Not as ... as kamroq darajani bildiradi. Ikkinchi as ni unutmaymiz.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: The number of visitors to City A was not as high as that for City B in 2015.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2015-yilda A shahriga tashrif buyuruvchilar soni B shahridagidek ko‘p bo‘lmagan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X was not as + adjective + as Y.
Esda tuting: Not as ... as kamroq darajani bildiradi. Ikkinchi as ni unutmaymiz.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Qiyosiy daraja (Comparatives). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'ning yarmi qiyoslashdan iborat: «higher than», «more expensive than», «twice as many as». Qiyosiy daraja xatolari — «more higher», «as bigger as» — imtihonda eng ko'p ko'zga tashlanadigan xatolardan biri.

Qisqa va uzun sifatlar. Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga -er qo'shiladi: higher, cheaper, larger. Ikki va undan ortiq bo'g'inlilarda more ishlatiladi: more expensive, more efficient. Ikkisini birga ishlatish xato: «more higher».

than va as ... as. Qiyosiy daraja than bilan: «higher than in 2010». Tenglik as ... as bilan: «as expensive as»; inkor not as ... as: «not as high as». «Than» o'rniga «then» yozish — tez-tez uchraydigan imlo xatosi.

Noto'g'ri shakllar. good — better, bad — worse, far — further, little — less, many/much — more. Bu shakllar -er yoki more olmaydi: «gooder», «more better», «more worse» — barchasi xato. Imtihonda eng ko'p uchraydigan xato aynan «more better» birikmasidir.

Task 1'da qiyoslash. «Twice as high as», «three times more than», «slightly higher than», «considerably lower than». Bu tuzilmalar raqamlarni izohlashda aniqlik beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000».

items.answer:
The horizontal bar chart shows museum visits across four fictional cities in 2015 and 2025, with the numbers expressed in thousands.

Overall, visits increased in every city. City B attracted the greatest number of visitors in both years, whereas city C recorded the lowest figures.

In 2015, city A received 16 thousand visits, while city B recorded 25 thousand. The figures for cities C and D were 12 and 22 thousand, respectively. City B therefore led city D by a relatively small margin.

By 2025, visits to city B had doubled to 50 thousand, which remained the highest figure. City D also doubled, reaching 44 thousand, while city A grew to 38 thousand and city C to 32 thousand.

The increase in city C amounted to 20 thousand, compared with 22 thousand in city A and D and 25 thousand in city B. Although city C remained last, the difference between it and city A narrowed.

units.title: Raqamni gapga joylash
units.simple_explanation: Raqamni alohida tashlab qo‘ymang. Qaysi kategoriya, qaysi yil va qaysi birlikligini yozing. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: In YEAR, X stood at N, compared with M for Y.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Raqamni gapga joylash». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Raqamni alohida tashlab qo‘ymang. Qaysi kategoriya, qaysi yil va qaysi birlikligini yozing.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: In 2025, City D's museums received 43 thousand visitors, compared with 25 thousand in 2020.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: D shahri muzeylariga 2025-yilda 43 ming kishi, 2020-yilda esa 25 ming kishi tashrif buyurgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: In YEAR, X stood at N, compared with M for Y.
Esda tuting: Raqamni alohida tashlab qo‘ymang. Qaysi kategoriya, qaysi yil va qaysi birlikligini yozing.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1 uchun qiyoslash tuzilmalari (Comparison Structures). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da raqamlarni shunchaki sanab chiqish yetarli emas — ularni qiyoslash kerak. Bu darsda beshta asosiy qiyoslash tuzilmasi va ularning aniq ishlatilishi ko'rsatiladi. Baholovchi aynan qiyoslash orqali «overview» qobiliyatini baholaydi.

As ... as va nisbat. «Twice as high as», «three times as many as», «half as much as». Bu tuzilmalar aniq nisbatni beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000». «Twice higher» emas, «twice as high» — to'g'ri shakl.

By + far / considerably. Farqni kuchaytirish uchun ravishlar qo'shiladi: considerably higher, significantly lower, slightly more, marginally less, by far the highest. Bu ravishlar farqning kattaligini aniq bildiradi va hisobotni yuzaki «higher/lower» dan ajratib turadi.

Whereas va compared with. «Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated». «Compared with 2010, the figure doubled». Bu tuzilmalar ikki ko'rsatkichni bir gapda qiyoslash imkonini beradi va matnni zichlashtiradi.

Proportion va raqam. «The proportion of X was higher than that of Y» (foizlar uchun), «The number of X exceeded that of Y» (sonlar uchun). Proportion va number ni aralashtirmang: proportion foizda, number sonda o'lchanadi.

Overall, each city recorded an increase over the period. City C had the most visitors in 2020, while city B became the leading city by 2025.

In 2020, city A registered 20 thousand visits and city D recorded 25 thousand. The corresponding figures for city B and city C were 30 and 45 thousand, making city C clearly the most visited destination at the beginning.

Five years later, the total for city A had increased to 35 thousand, while city D reached 43 thousand. City C experienced a more modest rise to 51 thousand, but city B grew sharply to 55 thousand visits.

The largest absolute increase was in city B, at 25 thousand visits, compared with 15 thousand in city A, 18 thousand in city D and only 6 thousand in city C. The chart does not identify the reasons for these changes.

Daraja ravishlari (significantly, slightly) farqning kattaligini, munosabat ravishlari (arguably, undoubtedly) muallifning pozitsiyasini bildiradi. Task 2'da bu ikki guruh inshoga aniqlik va tahliliy chuqurlik beradi — agar me'yorida ishlatilsa.

Daraja ravishlari. Kuchli: significantly, considerably, substantially, dramatically, sharply. O'rtacha: moderately, noticeably. Kuchsiz: slightly, marginally, modestly. Bu shkala Task 1'da farqni aniq tavsiflash, Task 2'da dalilni baholash uchun kerak.

Munosabat ravishlari. Arguably (ehtimol, asosli tarzda), undoubtedly (shubhasiz), presumably (ehtimol), reportedly (aytilishicha), notably (xususan), surprisingly. The line chart illustrates the number of passengers using two fictional bus routes between 2016 and 2026, with values measured in thousands.

Overall, passenger numbers on route A fluctuated considerably but ended higher than they began, whereas route B remained almost unchanged throughout the period.

Route A served 36 thousand passengers in 2016, below the 43 thousand recorded for route B. Two years later, route A had risen sharply to 49 thousand, overtaking route B, which had edged down to 42 thousand.

By 2020, route A had climbed to 65 thousand passengers. It then fell to 52 thousand in 2022 and 50 thousand in 2024 before recovering to 68 thousand in 2026. Route B, in contrast, moved only slightly, staying between 42 and 44 thousand.

Thus, route A ended the period 24 thousand passengers above route B. It also had a much wider range between its lowest and highest readings. No reasons for the fluctuations are supplied in the chart.

Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — some, any, much, many, a lot of (Quantifiers I). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Miqdor so'zlari otning sanaladigan yoki sanalmaydigan ekaniga qarab tanlanadi. «Many informations», «much people» — klassik xatolar. Task 1'da raqamlarni tavsiflashda bu so'zlar doimiy ishlatiladi, shuning uchun ularni avtomatlashtirish kerak.

many va much. many sanaladigan ko'plik otlar bilan: many students, many cities. much sanalmaydigan otlar bilan: much research, much traffic. Ikkisi asosan inkor va savollarda, shuningdek rasmiy yozuvda ishlatiladi.

a lot of / lots of. Ikkala turdagi otlar bilan ham ishlaydi va ko'pincha darak gaplarda much/many o'rnini egallaydi: «a lot of people», «a lot of information». Akademik yozuvda «a considerable amount of», «a large number of» afzalroq.

some va any. some darak gaplarda: «Some studies suggest...». any inkor va savollarda: «There is not any evidence». Taklif va iltimosda some ishlatiladi: «Would you like some water?» Rasmiy matnda any ko'pincha «hech qanday» ma'nosida: «without any delay».

Akademik alternativalar. «A significant number of», «a substantial amount of», «a considerable proportion of», «the majority of». Bu tuzilmalar aniqroq va rasmiyroq: «A significant number of students» — «many students» dan kuchliroq.

items.answer:
The two pie charts compare students’ preferred ways of studying in 2015 and 2025, divided into classroom, online and hybrid learning.

Overall, classroom-based learning lost its leading position over the ten-year period, while online and hybrid methods gained popularity. Online study became the largest single category in 2025.

In 2015, 56 percent of students preferred classroom learning, making it the clear majority choice. Online study represented 29 percent, while a further 15 percent preferred a hybrid approach.

By 2025, the classroom share had fallen to 39 percent. In contrast, the preference for online learning had risen to 42 percent, and hybrid learning accounted for 19 percent. The online category therefore moved ahead of traditional classroom study.

In percentage-point terms, classroom learning declined by 17 points. Online learning rose by 13 points, and the hybrid option gained four points. The diagrams only show preferences and do not establish any cause for the change.

units.simple_explanation: Twice as many as sonlar uchun, twice as much as miqdor uchun ishlatiladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: X was twice/three times as + adjective/many + as Y.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Multiplier: times as...as». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Twice as many as sonlar uchun, twice as much as miqdor uchun ishlatiladi.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: City B received twice as many museum visitors in 2025 as it did in 2015.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: B shahridagi muzeylarga 2025-yilda 2015-yildagidan ikki baravar ko‘p tashrif buyuruvchi kelgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X was twice/three times as + adjective/many + as Y.
Esda tuting: Twice as many as sonlar uchun, twice as much as miqdor uchun ishlatiladi.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Qiyosiy daraja (Comparatives). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'ning yarmi qiyoslashdan iborat: «higher than», «more expensive than», «twice as many as». Qiyosiy daraja xatolari — «more higher», «as bigger as» — imtihonda eng ko'p ko'zga tashlanadigan xatolardan biri.

Qisqa va uzun sifatlar. Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga -er qo'shiladi: higher, cheaper, larger. Ikki va undan ortiq bo'g'inlilarda more ishlatiladi: more expensive, more efficient. Ikkisini birga ishlatish xato: «more higher».

than va as ... as. Qiyosiy daraja than bilan: «higher than in 2010». Tenglik as ... as bilan: «as expensive as»; inkor not as ... as: «not as high as». «Than» o'rniga «then» yozish — tez-tez uchraydigan imlo xatosi.

Noto'g'ri shakllar. good — better, bad — worse, far — further, little — less, many/much — more. Bu shakllar -er yoki more olmaydi: «gooder», «more better», «more worse» — barchasi xato. Imtihonda eng ko'p uchraydigan xato aynan «more better» birikmasidir.

Task 1'da qiyoslash. «Twice as high as», «three times more than», «slightly higher than», «considerably lower than». Bu tuzilmalar raqamlarni izohlashda aniqlik beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000».

items.answer:
The horizontal bar chart shows museum visits across four fictional cities in 2015 and 2025, with the numbers expressed in thousands.

Overall, visits increased in every city. City B attracted the greatest number of visitors in both years, whereas city C recorded the lowest figures.

In 2015, city A received 16 thousand visits, while city B recorded 25 thousand. The figures for cities C and D were 12 and 22 thousand, respectively. City B therefore led city D by a relatively small margin.

By 2025, visits to city B had doubled to 50 thousand, which remained the highest figure. City D also doubled, reaching 44 thousand, while city A grew to 38 thousand and city C to 32 thousand.

The increase in city C amounted to 20 thousand, compared with 22 thousand in city A and D and 25 thousand in city B. Although city C remained last, the difference between it and city A narrowed.

units.title: O'rin va reyting
units.simple_explanation: Reytingda qaysi kategoriya yuqorida yoki pastda ekanini ochiq yozing. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: X ranked first/second; X had the largest/smallest share.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «O'rin va reyting». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Reytingda qaysi kategoriya yuqorida yoki pastda ekanini ochiq yozing.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: In 2025, City B ranked first with 50 thousand museum visitors, followed by City D with 44 thousand.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2025-yilda B shahri 50 ming tashrif buyuruvchi bilan birinchi, D shahri esa 44 ming bilan ikkinchi o‘rinni egallagan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: X ranked first/second; X had the largest/smallest share.
Esda tuting: Reytingda qaysi kategoriya yuqorida yoki pastda ekanini ochiq yozing.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Orttirma daraja (Superlatives). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Orttirma daraja eng yuqori darajani bildiradi va doim the bilan keladi: «the highest rate», «the most significant increase». Task 1'da eng katta va eng kichik ko'rsatkichlarni ajratib ko'rsatish uchun, Task 2'da eng muhim omilni ta'kidlash uchun kerak.
Shakl. Qisqa sifatlar -est oladi: the highest, the cheapest. Uzun sifatlar the most bilan: the most expensive, the most effective. Noto'g'ri shakllar: the best, the worst, the furthest, the least.

the majburiy. Orttirma daraja deyarli doim the bilan ishlatiladi: «the highest proportion», «the most popular choice». the siz ishlatish xato hisoblanadi. Faqat ot tushirib qoldirilgan qisqa javoblarda ham the saqlanadi: «This is the best».

Guruh ichida. Orttirma daraja qiyoslanayotgan guruhni ko'rsatadi: «the highest rate among developed countries», «the most expensive city in the world». in, of va among predloglari guruhni belgilaydi va qiyoslash chegarasini aniq qiladi. Bu detal Task 1'da aniqlik uchun muhim.

Task 1 va Task 2'da. Task 1: «The highest figure was recorded in 2010», «The most dramatic decline occurred in 2020». Task 2: «The most effective solution is to invest in education». Bu tuzilma xulosa va taqqoslashda kuchli.

Esda tuting: Whereas va while ikki farqli tendensiyani bir gapga bog‘laydi.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Bog'lovchilar: qo'shish, qarama-qarshilik, sabab (Linking Words). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Bog'lovchilar matnni bog'laydi, lekin ularning noto'g'ri tanlanishi yoki haddan tashqari ko'p ishlatilishi ohangni buzadi. Bu darsda to'rt guruh bog'lovchi, ularning tinish qoidalari va imtihondagi me'yoriy ishlatilishi ko'rsatiladi.

Qo'shish. moreover, furthermore, in addition, additionally, also, besides. «Moreover» va «furthermore» rasmiy, «also» neytral, «besides» ko'proq og'zaki. Ular gap boshida vergul bilan yoki gap o'rtasida keladi.

Qarama-qarshilik. however, nevertheless, nonetheless, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, although. «However» eng ko'p ishlatiladigan, lekin har xatboshida takrorlansa matn sun'iy bo'ladi. Almashtirib turing: nevertheless, in contrast, by contrast.

Sabab va natija. because, since, as, due to, therefore, consequently, as a result, thus. «Therefore» va «consequently» natijani bildiradi va rasmiy. «Because of» predlogli birikma, «because» bog'lovchi: «because of the rain» va «because it rained».

Misol va xulosa. for example, for instance, such as, namely; in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance. «Such as» ro'yxat kiritadi, «for example» alohida misol. Xulosa uchun «in conclusion» yetarli — «to sum up» bilan birga ishlatilmaydi.

The bar chart compares the number of visits to museums in four fictional cities in 2020 and 2025. All figures are given in thousands.

Overall, each city recorded an increase over the period. City C had the most visitors in 2020, while city B became the leading city by 2025.

In 2020, city A registered 20 thousand visits and city D recorded 25 thousand. The corresponding figures for city B and city C were 30 and 45 thousand, making city C clearly the most visited destination at the beginning.

Five years later, the total for city A had increased to 35 thousand, while city D reached 43 thousand. City C experienced a more modest rise to 51 thousand, but city B grew sharply to 55 thousand visits.

Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Orttirma daraja (Superlatives). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Orttirma daraja eng yuqori darajani bildiradi va doim the bilan keladi: «the highest rate», «the most significant increase». Task 1'da eng katta va eng kichik ko'rsatkichlarni ajratib ko'rsatish uchun, Task 2'da eng muhim omilni ta'kidlash uchun kerak.
Shakl. Qisqa sifatlar -est oladi: the highest, the cheapest. Uzun sifatlar the most bilan: the most expensive, the most effective. Noto'g'ri shakllar: the best, the worst, the furthest, the least.

the majburiy. Orttirma daraja deyarli doim the bilan ishlatiladi: «the highest proportion», «the most popular choice». the siz ishlatish xato hisoblanadi. Faqat ot tushirib qoldirilgan qisqa javoblarda ham the saqlanadi: «This is the best».

Guruh ichida. Orttirma daraja qiyoslanayotgan guruhni ko'rsatadi: «the highest rate among developed countries», «the most expensive city in the world». in, of va among predloglari guruhni belgilaydi va qiyoslash chegarasini aniq qiladi. Bu detal Task 1'da aniqlik uchun muhim.

Task 1 va Task 2'da. Task 1: «The highest figure was recorded in 2010», «The most dramatic decline occurred in 2020». Task 2: «The most effective solution is to invest in education». Bu tuzilma xulosa va taqqoslashda kuchli.

The horizontal bar chart shows museum visits across four fictional cities in 2015 and 2025, with the numbers expressed in thousands.

Overall, visits increased in every city. City B attracted the greatest number of visitors in both years, whereas city C recorded the lowest figures.

In 2015, city A received 16 thousand visits, while city B recorded 25 thousand. The figures for cities C and D were 12 and 22 thousand, respectively. City B therefore led city D by a relatively small margin.

By 2025, visits to city B had doubled to 50 thousand, which remained the highest figure. City D also doubled, reaching 44 thousand, while city A grew to 38 thousand and city C to 32 thousand.

The increase in city C amounted to 20 thousand, compared with 22 thousand in city A and D and 25 thousand in city B. Although city C remained last, the difference between it and city A narrowed.

units.simple_explanation: Taxminni juda aniq raqamdek ko‘rsatmang. Just over biroz ko‘proq degani. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: approximately/about/around N; just over/under N; nearly N.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Taxminiy raqamlar: approximately, around, just over, nearly». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Taxminni juda aniq raqamdek ko‘rsatmang. Just over biroz ko‘proq degani.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: Region C's internet-access rate stood at approximately 55% in 2025.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: C hududida internetga ulanish darajasi 2025-yilda taxminan 55 foizni tashkil etgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: approximately/about/around N; just over/under N; nearly N.
Esda tuting: Taxminni juda aniq raqamdek ko‘rsatmang. Just over biroz ko‘proq degani.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Daraja va munosabat ravishlari (Degree and Stance Adverbs). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Daraja ravishlari (significantly, slightly) farqning kattaligini, munosabat ravishlari (arguably, undoubtedly) muallifning pozitsiyasini bildiradi. Task 2'da bu ikki guruh inshoga aniqlik va tahliliy chuqurlik beradi — agar me'yorida ishlatilsa.

Daraja ravishlari. Kuchli: significantly, considerably, substantially, dramatically, sharply. O'rtacha: moderately, noticeably. Kuchsiz: slightly, marginally, modestly. Bu shkala Task 1'da farqni aniq tavsiflash, Task 2'da dalilni baholash uchun kerak.

Munosabat ravishlari. Arguably (ehtimol, asosli tarzda), undoubtedly (shubhasiz), presumably (ehtimol), reportedly (aytilishicha), notably (xususan), surprisingly. Ular muallifning ishonch darajasini ko'rsatadi va matnga ovoz qo'shadi. Task 2'da bu ravishlar dalilni baholashda, xulosada esa pozitsiyani yakunlashda ishlatiladi.

O'rni. Daraja ravishi fe'ldan keyin yoki oldin: «rose significantly» / «significantly rose». Munosabat ravishi gap boshida, vergul bilan: «Arguably, the policy has failed». Gap o'rtasida ham mumkin: «The policy has arguably failed» — bu variant yanada ehtiyotkor.

Me'yor. Har bir gapda ravish ishlatish matnni sun'iy qiladi. O'rinli ishlatish: asosiy dalilni baholashda va xulosada bittadan. «Undoubtedly», «definitely», «certainly» kabi qat'iy ravishlarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlating — ular dalilsiz da'voni kuchaytiradi.

items.answer:
The line graph compares the proportion of households with internet access in three fictional regions from 2010 to 2025.

Overall, all three regions experienced growth, but the rise was much stronger in regions A and B than in region C. Region C started with the largest proportion, while region A finished in first place.

In 2010, the figure for region A was 28 percent, compared with just 20 percent for region B and 45 percent for region C. By 2015, these figures had increased to 41, 36 and 48 percent, respectively. Region C therefore remained ahead at the midpoint of the period.

Region A continued to rise, reaching 57 percent in 2020 and 76 percent in 2025. Region B also climbed steadily, from 48 percent in 2020 to 67 percent five years later. In comparison, region C increased more slowly, reaching 52 and then 55 percent.

By the end of the period, the gap between regions A and C stood at 21 percentage points. Region B, despite starting last, overtook region C by 2025. The graph provides no information about why these differences occurred.

units.title: Taqqoslash iboralari: compared with, whereas, as opposed to
units.simple_explanation: Taqqoslayotgan ikkita narsani grammatik jihatdan bir xil turdagi birliklar bilan ifodalang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: Compared with X, Y was ...; X rose, whereas Y fell.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Taqqoslash iboralari: compared with, whereas, as opposed to». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Taqqoslayotgan ikkita narsani grammatik jihatdan bir xil turdagi birliklar bilan ifodalang.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: Compared with 2020, the number of museum visitors to City D rose from 25 thousand to 43 thousand in 2025.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2020-yil bilan taqqoslaganda, D shahri muzeylariga tashriflar 2025-yilda 25 mingdan 43 minggacha oshgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: Compared with X, Y was ...; X rose, whereas Y fell.
Esda tuting: Taqqoslayotgan ikkita narsani grammatik jihatdan bir xil turdagi birliklar bilan ifodalang.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1 uchun qiyoslash tuzilmalari (Comparison Structures). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da raqamlarni shunchaki sanab chiqish yetarli emas — ularni qiyoslash kerak. Bu darsda beshta asosiy qiyoslash tuzilmasi va ularning aniq ishlatilishi ko'rsatiladi. Baholovchi aynan qiyoslash orqali «overview» qobiliyatini baholaydi.

As ... as va nisbat. «Twice as high as», «three times as many as», «half as much as». Bu tuzilmalar aniq nisbatni beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000». «Twice higher» emas, «twice as high» — to'g'ri shakl.

By + far / considerably. Farqni kuchaytirish uchun ravishlar qo'shiladi: considerably higher, significantly lower, slightly more, marginally less, by far the highest. Bu ravishlar farqning kattaligini aniq bildiradi va hisobotni yuzaki «higher/lower» dan ajratib turadi.

Whereas va compared with. «Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated». «Compared with 2010, the figure doubled». Bu tuzilmalar ikki ko'rsatkichni bir gapda qiyoslash imkonini beradi va matnni zichlashtiradi.

Proportion va raqam. «The proportion of X was higher than that of Y» (foizlar uchun), «The number of X exceeded that of Y» (sonlar uchun). Proportion va number ni aralashtirmang: proportion foizda, number sonda o'lchanadi.

The bar chart compares the number of visits to museums in four fictional cities in 2020 and 2025. All figures are given in thousands.

Overall, each city recorded an increase over the period. City C had the most visitors in 2020, while city B became the leading city by 2025.

In 2020, city A registered 20 thousand visits and city D recorded 25 thousand. The corresponding figures for city B and city C were 30 and 45 thousand, making city C clearly the most visited destination at the beginning.

Five years later, the total for city A had increased to 35 thousand, while city D reached 43 thousand. City C experienced a more modest rise to 51 thousand, but city B grew sharply to 55 thousand visits.

The largest absolute increase was in city B, at 25 thousand visits, compared with 15 thousand in city A, 18 thousand in city D and only 6 thousand in city C. The chart does not identify the reasons for these changes.

units.title: Foiz va foiz punkti: percentage points
units.simple_explanation: Foizning nisbiy oshishi va foiz punktidagi mutlaq farqni adashtirmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: from 20% to 30% = a rise of 10 percentage points.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Foiz va foiz punkti: percentage points». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Foizning nisbiy oshishi va foiz punktidagi mutlaq farqni adashtirmang.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: Library satisfaction rose from 40% to 60%, an increase of 20 percentage points.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: Kutubxonadan qoniqish 40 foizdan 60 foizgacha oshgan, ya’ni 20 foiz punktiga ko‘paygan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: from 20% to 30% = a rise of 10 percentage points.
Esda tuting: Foizning nisbiy oshishi va foiz punktidagi mutlaq farqni adashtirmang.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — some, any, much, many, a lot of (Quantifiers I). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Miqdor so'zlari otning sanaladigan yoki sanalmaydigan ekaniga qarab tanlanadi. «Many informations», «much people» — klassik xatolar. Task 1'da raqamlarni tavsiflashda bu so'zlar doimiy ishlatiladi, shuning uchun ularni avtomatlashtirish kerak.

many va much. many sanaladigan ko'plik otlar bilan: many students, many cities. much sanalmaydigan otlar bilan: much research, much traffic. Ikkisi asosan inkor va savollarda, shuningdek rasmiy yozuvda ishlatiladi.

a lot of / lots of. Ikkala turdagi otlar bilan ham ishlaydi va ko'pincha darak gaplarda much/many o'rnini egallaydi: «a lot of people», «a lot of information». Akademik yozuvda «a considerable amount of», «a large number of» afzalroq.

some va any. some darak gaplarda: «Some studies suggest...». any inkor va savollarda: «There is not any evidence». Taklif va iltimosda some ishlatiladi: «Would you like some water?» Rasmiy matnda any ko'pincha «hech qanday» ma'nosida: «without any delay».

Akademik alternativalar. «A significant number of», «a substantial amount of», «a considerable proportion of», «the majority of». Bu tuzilmalar aniqroq va rasmiyroq: «A significant number of students» — «many students» dan kuchliroq.

The bar chart compares the share of students satisfied with three college facilities in 2020 and 2025.

Overall, all three facilities recorded higher satisfaction levels in 2025. Classrooms had the highest level of satisfaction in both years, while the library showed the largest improvement.

In 2020, 40 percent of respondents were satisfied with the library, compared with 55 percent for internet services and 60 percent for classrooms. The library was therefore clearly the lowest-rated facility.

By 2025, satisfaction with the library had risen to 60 percent. Internet services increased to 65 percent, while classrooms climbed to 75 percent, remaining the most positively rated category.

It is important to express the differences in percentage points: the library improved by 20 points, internet services by 10 points, and classrooms by 15 points. These figures describe changes in shares rather than relative percentage growth.

The reported values are proportions of satisfied respondents, not the total number of students. Therefore, all three differences are expressed using the same percentage-point scale.

deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: According to the survey, + result / proportion + chose X.
Esda tuting: So‘rov natijasini neytral yozing. Mashqdagi raqamlar haqiqiy statistik fakt emas.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1 uchun qiyoslash tuzilmalari (Comparison Structures). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da raqamlarni shunchaki sanab chiqish yetarli emas — ularni qiyoslash kerak. Bu darsda beshta asosiy qiyoslash tuzilmasi va ularning aniq ishlatilishi ko'rsatiladi. Baholovchi aynan qiyoslash orqali «overview» qobiliyatini baholaydi.

As ... as va nisbat. «Twice as high as», «three times as many as», «half as much as». Bu tuzilmalar aniq nisbatni beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000». «Twice higher» emas, «twice as high» — to'g'ri shakl.

By + far / considerably. Farqni kuchaytirish uchun ravishlar qo'shiladi: considerably higher, significantly lower, slightly more, marginally less, by far the highest. Bu ravishlar farqning kattaligini aniq bildiradi va hisobotni yuzaki «higher/lower» dan ajratib turadi.

Whereas va compared with. «Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated». «Compared with 2010, the figure doubled». Bu tuzilmalar ikki ko'rsatkichni bir gapda qiyoslash imkonini beradi va matnni zichlashtiradi.

Proportion va raqam. «The proportion of X was higher than that of Y» (foizlar uchun), «The number of X exceeded that of Y» (sonlar uchun). Proportion va number ni aralashtirmang: proportion foizda, number sonda o'lchanadi.

items.answer:
The table summarises the percentage of respondents rating four college services as good or excellent in 2020 and 2025.

Overall, ratings improved for teaching, library services and the internet. The cafeteria was the only category to experience a small decline, while the library registered the greatest increase.

In 2020, the cafeteria had the highest satisfaction rating, at 73 percent, followed by teaching at 68 percent. Internet services scored 55 percent, and the library was lowest, at just 42 percent.

By 2025, teaching had become the top-rated service with 76 percent. The cafeteria declined slightly to 70 percent. Ratings for internet services and the library rose to 64 percent and 61 percent, respectively.

In absolute terms, the library gained 19 percentage points, far more than teaching, which gained eight points, and internet services, which gained nine. The cafeteria fell by three points. The figures should not be interpreted as evidence of what caused the changes.

Esda tuting: Ikki diagramma orasidagi mantiqiy bog‘lanishni toping; mazmunni majburan birlashtirmang.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Bog'lovchilar: qo'shish, qarama-qarshilik, sabab (Linking Words). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Bog'lovchilar matnni bog'laydi, lekin ularning noto'g'ri tanlanishi yoki haddan tashqari ko'p ishlatilishi ohangni buzadi. Bu darsda to'rt guruh bog'lovchi, ularning tinish qoidalari va imtihondagi me'yoriy ishlatilishi ko'rsatiladi.

Qo'shish. moreover, furthermore, in addition, additionally, also, besides. «Moreover» va «furthermore» rasmiy, «also» neytral, «besides» ko'proq og'zaki. Ular gap boshida vergul bilan yoki gap o'rtasida keladi.

Qarama-qarshilik. however, nevertheless, nonetheless, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, although. «However» eng ko'p ishlatiladigan, lekin har xatboshida takrorlansa matn sun'iy bo'ladi. Almashtirib turing: nevertheless, in contrast, by contrast.

Sabab va natija. because, since, as, due to, therefore, consequently, as a result, thus. «Therefore» va «consequently» natijani bildiradi va rasmiy. «Because of» predlogli birikma, «because» bog'lovchi: «because of the rain» va «because it rained».

Misol va xulosa. for example, for instance, such as, namely; in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance. «Such as» ro'yxat kiritadi, «for example» alohida misol. Xulosa uchun «in conclusion» yetarli — «to sum up» bilan birga ishlatilmaydi.

items.answer:
The bar chart shows the purposes of trips in a fictional country in 2015 and 2025, while the accompanying table provides the total number of trips in each year.

Overall, the number of journeys increased from 116 thousand to 132 thousand, although the pattern varied by purpose. Study and leisure trips grew, whereas work-related trips declined.

In 2015, work was the most common reason for travel, accounting for 52 thousand journeys. Leisure represented 36 thousand trips, while study was responsible for the remaining 28 thousand.

By 2025, leisure had become the largest category, increasing to 48 thousand trips. Study travel also grew to 44 thousand, while work journeys fell to 40 thousand. The two expanding categories therefore more than offset the decline in work-related travel.

The table confirms that the overall increase was 16 thousand trips. This total is consistent with the sum of the categories in the bar chart. The information gives no explanation for changes in travel behaviour.

units.simple_explanation: Jadvalda o‘xshash kategoriyalarni mantiqan guruhlang, har katakni alohida sanamang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Jadvalni yozish: ma'lumotni guruhlash». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Jadvalda o‘xshash kategoriyalarni mantiqan guruhlang, har katakni alohida sanamang.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: In 2025, teaching (76%) and the cafeteria (70%) received the highest satisfaction ratings.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: 2025-yilda eng yuqori qoniqish ko‘rsatkichlari o‘qitish (76 foiz) va oshxonaga (70 foiz) tegishli bo‘lgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: The three smaller categories accounted for ... combined.
Esda tuting: Jadvalda o‘xshash kategoriyalarni mantiqan guruhlang, har katakni alohida sanamang.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Task 1 uchun qiyoslash tuzilmalari (Comparison Structures). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da raqamlarni shunchaki sanab chiqish yetarli emas — ularni qiyoslash kerak. Bu darsda beshta asosiy qiyoslash tuzilmasi va ularning aniq ishlatilishi ko'rsatiladi. Baholovchi aynan qiyoslash orqali «overview» qobiliyatini baholaydi.

As ... as va nisbat. «Twice as high as», «three times as many as», «half as much as». Bu tuzilmalar aniq nisbatni beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000». «Twice higher» emas, «twice as high» — to'g'ri shakl.

By + far / considerably. Farqni kuchaytirish uchun ravishlar qo'shiladi: considerably higher, significantly lower, slightly more, marginally less, by far the highest. Bu ravishlar farqning kattaligini aniq bildiradi va hisobotni yuzaki «higher/lower» dan ajratib turadi.

Whereas va compared with. «Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated». «Compared with 2010, the figure doubled». Bu tuzilmalar ikki ko'rsatkichni bir gapda qiyoslash imkonini beradi va matnni zichlashtiradi.

Proportion va raqam. «The proportion of X was higher than that of Y» (foizlar uchun), «The number of X exceeded that of Y» (sonlar uchun). Proportion va number ni aralashtirmang: proportion foizda, number sonda o'lchanadi.

items.answer:
The table summarises the percentage of respondents rating four college services as good or excellent in 2020 and 2025.

Overall, ratings improved for teaching, library services and the internet. The cafeteria was the only category to experience a small decline, while the library registered the greatest increase.

In 2020, the cafeteria had the highest satisfaction rating, at 73 percent, followed by teaching at 68 percent. Internet services scored 55 percent, and the library was lowest, at just 42 percent.

By 2025, teaching had become the top-rated service with 76 percent. The cafeteria declined slightly to 70 percent. Ratings for internet services and the library rose to 64 percent and 61 percent, respectively.

In absolute terms, the library gained 19 percentage points, far more than teaching, which gained eight points, and internet services, which gained nine. The cafeteria fell by three points. The figures should not be interpreted as evidence of what caused the changes.

units.title: Xarita va jarayon
units.simple_explanation: Xaritada joylashuv va o‘zgarishni, jarayonda esa ketma-ketlikni tavsiflang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: The maps show changes to + place + between YEAR and YEAR.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Xarita va jarayon». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Xaritada joylashuv va o‘zgarishni, jarayonda esa ketma-ketlikni tavsiflang.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: The two maps show changes to the town centre between 2005 and 2025.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: Ikkita xarita 2005–2025-yillarda shahar markazidagi o‘zgarishlarni ko‘rsatadi.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: The maps show changes to + place + between YEAR and YEAR.
Esda tuting: Xaritada joylashuv va o‘zgarishni, jarayonda esa ketma-ketlikni tavsiflang.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Passiv: Task 1'da jarayon tavsifi (Passive in Process Description). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da jarayon diagrammasi (process diagram) berilganda, tavsifning 80-90 foizi passiv bo'ladi, chunki jarayonni kim bajarayotgani ko'rsatilmaydi. Bu darsda jarayonni bosqichma-bosqich tavsiflash tili va odatiy tuzilmalari ko'rsatiladi.

Present Simple passiv asos. Jarayon odatiy, takrorlanuvchi bo'lsa, Present Simple passiv ishlatiladi: «The beans are roasted», «The mixture is heated to 100 degrees». Har bir bosqich bitta passiv gap bo'lishi mumkin, lekin ularni bog'lovchilar bilan ulash kerak.

Bosqichlarni bog'lash. Ketma-ketlik so'zlari: first, then, next, after that, subsequently, finally. Ular gap boshida yoki fe'l oldidan turadi: «First, the raw materials are collected. They are then transported to the factory». Bu so'zlar Coherence and Cohesion uchun bevosita ball beradi.

Maqsadni ko'rsatish. Jarayonning maqsadini aytish uchun in order to, so as to, to + infinitiv ishlatiladi: «The waste is compressed in order to reduce its volume». Bu tuzilma tavsifni mazmunli qiladi, aks holda matn quruq ro'yxatga aylanadi.

Nima qilmaslik kerak. Har bir bosqichni alohida gap qilib yozish matnni bolalarcha qiladi. Bosqichlarni birlashtiring, bir xil fe'lni takrorlamang va «then the next step is that...» kabi og'ir tuzilmalardan qoching. Faol fe'llar: processed, converted, delivered, stored, packaged.

items.answer:
The two maps illustrate changes to a fictional town centre between 2005 and 2025.

Overall, the town centre became more developed, with new public services and higher-density housing. However, its main east–west road, bus stop and park were retained.

In 2005, a park occupied the western part of the northern section of the town centre. A market stood in the middle, and individual homes were situated to the east. A main road ran across the lower half of the map, with a bus stop to the southwest.

By 2025, the original market had been replaced by a clinic. The former homes in the northeast had made way for flats, while a cycle lane had been added near the southeast. The park continued to occupy its original position.

The road and bus stop also remained unchanged. The main developments were therefore the replacement of the market, the introduction of flats and the creation of a cycle route. No scale or distances are provided.
