units.title: Xarita: joylashuv va o'zgarish iboralari
units.simple_explanation: North/south/east/west oldidan to the ishlatilishi mumkin; o‘zgarish uchun passive foydali. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: A new road was built to the east of the station.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Xarita: joylashuv va o'zgarish iboralari». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: North/south/east/west oldidan to the ishlatilishi mumkin; o‘zgarish uchun passive foydali.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: A clinic replaced the market in the central part of the town, while new flats appeared to the east.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: Shahar markazida bozor o‘rniga poliklinika qurilgan, sharq tomonda esa yangi ko‘p qavatli uylar paydo bo‘lgan.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: A new road was built to the east of the station.
Esda tuting: North/south/east/west oldidan to the ishlatilishi mumkin; o‘zgarish uchun passive foydali.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — O'rin va harakat predloglari (Prepositions of Place). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

in, on, at nafaqat vaqt, balki o'rin uchun ham ishlatiladi: in the city, on the coast, at the station. Task 1'da jarayon va joylashuvni tavsiflashda, Task 2'da hududiy farqlarni ko'rsatishda bu predloglar doimiy kerak bo'ladi.

in, on, at. in — biror hudud ichida: in the city, in rural areas, in Europe. on — yuzada yoki chiziq bo'ylab: on the coast, on the border, on the map. at — aniq nuqta: at the station, at the entrance, at the crossroads.

Harakat predloglari. to — yo'nalish: moved to cities, went to school. into — ichkariga: migrated into urban areas. from — manba: from rural areas. across — bo'ylab: across the country. through — ichidan: through the tunnel.

Joylashuv tuzilmalari. located in, situated in, based in — rasmiy tavsif uchun: «The factory is located in the northern region». «In the north of the country» — hudud ichida; «to the north of» — tashqarida.

Task 1'da. Jarayon diagrammasida: «The water is pumped from the river to the treatment plant». Xarita tavsifida: «The site is located to the east of the town centre». Bu tuzilmalar aniqlik va ravonlik beradi.

units.simple_explanation: Jarayonda ketma-ketlik so‘zlari va is/are + past participle ishlatiladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: First, X is collected; then it is sorted and finally packaged.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Jarayon: ketma-ketlik va passive». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Jarayonda ketma-ketlik so‘zlari va is/are + past participle ishlatiladi.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: First, the olives are harvested and washed; next, they are crushed before being pressed.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: Avval zaytunlar terilib yuviladi; keyin ular eziladi va shundan so‘ng presslanadi.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.

Esda tuting: Jarayonda ketma-ketlik so‘zlari va is/are + past participle ishlatiladi.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Passiv: Task 1'da jarayon tavsifi (Passive in Process Description). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da jarayon diagrammasi (process diagram) berilganda, tavsifning 80-90 foizi passiv bo'ladi, chunki jarayonni kim bajarayotgani ko'rsatilmaydi. Bu darsda jarayonni bosqichma-bosqich tavsiflash tili va odatiy tuzilmalari ko'rsatiladi.

Present Simple passiv asos. Jarayon odatiy, takrorlanuvchi bo'lsa, Present Simple passiv ishlatiladi: «The beans are roasted», «The mixture is heated to 100 degrees». Har bir bosqich bitta passiv gap bo'lishi mumkin, lekin ularni bog'lovchilar bilan ulash kerak.

Bosqichlarni bog'lash. Ketma-ketlik so'zlari: first, then, next, after that, subsequently, finally. Ular gap boshida yoki fe'l oldidan turadi: «First, the raw materials are collected. They are then transported to the factory». Bu so'zlar Coherence and Cohesion uchun bevosita ball beradi.

Maqsadni ko'rsatish. Jarayonning maqsadini aytish uchun in order to, so as to, to + infinitiv ishlatiladi: «The waste is compressed in order to reduce its volume». Bu tuzilma tavsifni mazmunli qiladi, aks holda matn quruq ro'yxatga aylanadi.

Nima qilmaslik kerak. Har bir bosqichni alohida gap qilib yozish matnni bolalarcha qiladi. Bosqichlarni birlashtiring, bir xil fe'lni takrorlamang va «then the next step is that...» kabi og'ir tuzilmalardan qoching. Faol fe'llar: processed, converted, delivered, stored, packaged.

items.answer:
The diagram shows a simplified six-stage process for producing olive oil, beginning with harvested olives and ending with the bottled product.

Overall, the production of olive oil involves a sequence of preparation, extraction and packaging stages. The olives are first cleaned and broken down before the liquid is pressed and separated.

At the first stage, olives are harvested and then washed thoroughly to remove unwanted material. Once cleaned, they are crushed into a paste. These steps prepare the fruit for the subsequent extraction stages.

The paste is then pressed, allowing the liquid component to be extracted. In the fifth stage, the oil is separated from the water and other remaining material. Finally, the resulting olive oil is transferred into bottles.

The process is presented as a linear sequence with no branches or repeated stages. The diagram does not specify how long the individual operations take, so no duration should be added to the report.

Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Passiv: asosiy qoidalar (Passive Voice Basics). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Passiv ovoz harakatning bajaruvchisini emas, harakatning o'zini va natijasini oldingi o'ringa chiqaradi. Akademik yozuvda u xolislik va masofa yaratadi: «The data were collected in 2020» kim to'plaganini aytish shart emas. Task 1'da jarayon tavsifi deyarli butunlay passivga tayanadi.

Shakl: be + V3. Passiv har qanday zamonda be fe'lining mos shakli va uchinchi shakl (V3) bilan quriladi: is built, was built, has been built, will be built, is being built. Bajaruvchi kerak bo'lsa, by bilan qo'shiladi: «The report was written by the committee».

Qachon ishlatiladi. Bajaruvchi noma'lum (The window was broken), ahamiyatsiz (The road is being repaired) yoki kontekstdan aniq (The suspect was arrested) bo'lsa. Shuningdek, natija va jarayon muhim bo'lganda: «Millions of tonnes of waste are produced every year».

O'timsiz fe'llar passivga o'tmaydi. happen, occur, appear, arrive, consist, exist, rise, fall kabi o'timsiz fe'llar to'ldiruvchi olmaydi, shuning uchun passiv bo'la olmaydi. «The accident was happened» — xato. «The accident happened» — to'g'ri.

Akademik ohang. Passiv «I», «we», «people» kabi noaniq egalarni yo'q qiladi va matnni rasmiylashtiradi: «It is widely believed» emas, «Many scholars argue» kabi aktiv tuzilmalar ham kerak. Passivni haddan tashqari ishlatish matnni sust qiladi: nisbat taxminan 30-40 foiz bo'lishi maqbul.

items.answer:
The diagram illustrates a simplified natural water cycle, consisting of evaporation, condensation, precipitation and collection.

Overall, this is a continuous circular process rather than a sequence with a clear beginning or end. Water changes location and physical state before returning to the point from which the cycle can repeat.

During evaporation, liquid water is converted into water vapour. This vapour moves into the atmosphere, where it cools and condenses into tiny droplets that can form clouds.

The accumulated water subsequently returns to the ground as precipitation. Rainwater then gathers in rivers, lakes or other bodies of water. From these locations, the evaporation stage can occur again.

The illustration contains four principal stages and uses arrows to show their order. There are no numerical measurements or time periods, so a suitable account should focus on the changes and their sequence.

The four stages are connected by the movement of water through the environment. Unlike a manufacturing process, this cycle has no final product and can continue repeatedly.

units.title: Diagramma va asbob: consists of, is located, is used to
units.simple_explanation: Qurilmaning qismlarini va vazifasini ayting. Consists of dan keyin qismlar keladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.
units.formula: The device consists of X and Y; X is used to + V.
units.specific_rule: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Diagramma va asbob: consists of, is located, is used to». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
steps: 1. Oson qoida: Qurilmaning qismlarini va vazifasini ayting. Consists of dan keyin qismlar keladi.
2. Qolipga mos tabiiy misol: The water filter consists of a chamber with three layers, an outlet pipe and a storage container.
3. O‘zbekcha ma’nosi: Suv filtri uch qatlamli kamera, chiqish quvuri va suv saqlash idishidan iborat.
4. Birinchi misoldagi ega, fe’l va asosiy qolipni toping, o‘zingizning fikringizga moslab yozing.
warnings: Birinchi misol fokus mavzusini ko‘rsatadi; qolganlarining ayrimlari grammatik poydevor uchun yondosh misollardir.
Avval aniqlik, keyin murakkablik. Keraksiz inversiya bilan xatoni ko‘paytirmang.
Writing band bahosi faqat grammatik tuzilma soniga bog‘liq emas.
Grafikdagi barcha statistik raqamlar faqat mashq uchun to‘qilgan misollardir.
deep_rules: Darsning aniq grammatik formulasi: The device consists of X and Y; X is used to + V.
Esda tuting: Qurilmaning qismlarini va vazifasini ayting. Consists of dan keyin qismlar keladi.
Bog‘liq grammatik poydevor — Passiv: Task 1'da jarayon tavsifi (Passive in Process Description). Quyidagi nazariya aynan shu qoida bilan bog‘liq yordamchi mavzuni ham tushuntiradi.

Task 1'da jarayon diagrammasi (process diagram) berilganda, tavsifning 80-90 foizi passiv bo'ladi, chunki jarayonni kim bajarayotgani ko'rsatilmaydi. Bu darsda jarayonni bosqichma-bosqich tavsiflash tili va odatiy tuzilmalari ko'rsatiladi.

Present Simple passiv asos. Jarayon odatiy, takrorlanuvchi bo'lsa, Present Simple passiv ishlatiladi: «The beans are roasted», «The mixture is heated to 100 degrees». Har bir bosqich bitta passiv gap bo'lishi mumkin, lekin ularni bog'lovchilar bilan ulash kerak.

Bosqichlarni bog'lash. Ketma-ketlik so'zlari: first, then, next, after that, subsequently, finally. Ular gap boshida yoki fe'l oldidan turadi: «First, the raw materials are collected. They are then transported to the factory». Bu so'zlar Coherence and Cohesion uchun bevosita ball beradi.

Maqsadni ko'rsatish. Jarayonning maqsadini aytish uchun in order to, so as to, to + infinitiv ishlatiladi: «The waste is compressed in order to reduce its volume». Bu tuzilma tavsifni mazmunli qiladi, aks holda matn quruq ro'yxatga aylanadi.

Nima qilmaslik kerak. Har bir bosqichni alohida gap qilib yozish matnni bolalarcha qiladi. Bosqichlarni birlashtiring, bir xil fe'lni takrorlamang va «then the next step is that...» kabi og'ir tuzilmalardan qoching. Faol fe'llar: processed, converted, delivered, stored, packaged.

items.answer:
The schematic illustrates a simple gravity-powered water-filter device and the movement of water through its main components.

Overall, the apparatus consists of a filter chamber containing several layers, an outlet pipe and a separate storage container. Water enters at one end and leaves the system after moving through the filtration materials.

Initially, water is poured into the main chamber from the left. It then passes through three labelled filtration layers: sand near the top, gravel in the middle and charcoal at the bottom.

After passing through these materials, the water exits the chamber through an outlet pipe on the right. The pipe leads to a second container, where the filtered water is collected for storage.
